tuning_key.text: I lie in wonder how we've survived to make it this far / Spawning our species through the ages as we spin around our star
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: You've made it this far by moving through countless invisible patterns — not by force, but by belonging to something larger than yourself. Today, stop trying to decode the pattern and become still enough to let it move through you. The survival arc doesn't need your effort right now; it needs your presence. Stand at the center and let the ages pass.

practice.title: Spine Vertical
practice.instruction: Feel your spine as a still axis — not rigid, but centered — while everything around you continues to move and turn.

practice.title: Breath as Witness
practice.instruction: Let your breath be the only thing that moves; notice how each exhale releases a small piece of the effort you've been carrying.

practice.title: The Long Arc Through Me
practice.instruction: Listen to the echo — "I lie in wonder how we've survived to make it this far" — and let the survival of every generation before you settle into your bones as permission to simply be here, now.
